title: Conditional κ = 0.001675769763609769: mixed T37 allocation with source-holder fusions
body:
This draft composes **PR1195's two source-holder fusions with our globally allocated mixed-entrance T37 witness**, targeting conditional **κ = 0.001675769763609769**. PR1201's concurrent composition claims 0.001675767762856960; our allocation leaves two rank-one idle axes instead of eighteen. The original locally admitted mixed witness, κ = 0.001675672695827067, remains retained separately in this PR.

The construction has 125 calls of the fused joint-entrance D3 word and 208 calls of its four-group D4 variant. The source-holder fusions preserve every ordered helper width and centre/port interface. Fresh exact replay verifies both changed scalar programs; deterministic matching regenerates the same 159,840 literal whole-helper roles across 333 calls. The aggregate profile is `{1:783552,2:169496,3:136696,4:43790,5:26640,8:2664,48:11374}`, with rank mass 2,408,256 and deficit 11,840. No selected certificate is changed.

**Complete local verification passed:** the clean standalone fused-package replay completed `PASS_MIXED_FUSIONS_T37_COMPLETE_ADMISSION` on tested commit `d313cce94d7bb4dd8b15265cad0aa5fb77b2ecff`. It rebuilt the literal source-holder patch and both providers, checked both scalar orientations and all 704 columns, every native phase edge and wrapper, the entire independent physical owner map, and the strict controller, full invoice and exact assembly. It rejected 114 admission, 23 controller, 12 bit-supplier, 20 fusion, 11 entrance, eight flow, eight independent-owner and eight parent mutations. Two rational moment engines and 47 strict outer inequalities passed. The freshly rebuilt PR589/741/799 ancestry was fully rebound with fixed coverage checks. Exact receipts and the tested source manifest are retained in `research/mixed-fusions-t37/evidence/`; only evidence and its README pointer changed after that replay. The complete predecessor remains in `research/mixed-demotions-t37/evidence/`.

The final composition is in `research/mixed-fusions-t37/`. With the retained build dependencies installed:

```sh
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -B research/mixed-fusions-t37/verify.py --work /tmp/mixed-fusions-t37-new
```

This rebuilds the PR1195 literal patch from the pinned PR1148 source, refits no frames at verification time, rebuilds both providers, reconstructs the owners without an optimizer, and runs every strict stage plus fresh PR589/741/799 cold ancestry. Optional `--ancestry799` reuse rechecks all source/artifact/log bindings and mandatory stage coverage. The dedicated workflow runs the final fused package and uploads evidence. The broader local `make verify` run remains in progress and hosted checks are queued, so this remains a draft.

Credit: Marius-Paul Dumitrean / Claude Code's **PR1195** supplies the two source-holder fusions, literal patch, proof and controls; original files and notice are vendored. Thomas DiFiore's **PR1148** supplies the joint-entrance word and group-627 lead. **PR1201** independently composed these fusions with PR1192 and prompted this compatibility test; none of its word or owner payload is consumed. The original contribution in this PR is the 208-instance global mixed allocation and its independent admission. The mixed-provider idea also appeared concurrently in PR1176/1183/1192 and is not claimed as exclusive to this work.

Retain PR1111; PR864's frame model; PR1152's matching implementation; PR1129/1131's integer flow and wave order; Hao Yan/FanPUYen's PR858 geometry; PR870/1074 admission; PR795/890/942 signed prices and T37 construction; PR987/1018 scalar-word ancestry, PR1030 endpoints, PR559 and the unchanged PR589 bit supplier. Exact source pins and original notices are included.

Prepared for Jeremy Diviney with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and exact recovery, analytic transfer, PR559 recurrence correction and bit H1–H5 obligations remain. No unconditional theorem, general packing optimality, complete formalization or measured runtime gain is claimed.
